tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search Socketlist's scored MCP servers by keyword (e.g. "postgres", "browser automation", "jira"). Results are ordered by how well they match, then by Socketlist score (0-100), then GitHub stars. Leave query empty with a category to list the top servers in that category.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get one server's Socketlist score with its maintenance/security/adoption breakdown and flags, the signals behind it (stars, last push, licence, security policy), install commands, setup snippets for Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code, declared environment variables, an allowedMcpServers allowlist entry

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Socketlist's categories with how many scored servers each has and the top three by score. Use a category key with search_servers.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_server" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
